yaw_clause.rule: CCW (leftward) pattern motion must give L-R >= +1 Hz and CW must give L-R <= -1 Hz (syndirectional, the optomotor sign; DNa02 steers ipsilaterally)

gate.rule: LIF_DYNAMICS_SPEC §7.10 gate reused verbatim: DSI >= 0.2 in at least one T4/T5 subtype whose response magnitude is >= 0.5 mV, AND a DNa02 asymmetry |L-R| >= 1 Hz whose sign follows the stimulus in both directions (§9.9: evaluated on the yaw CCW / CW conditions)
